about: The one Report a problem form, read by the desktop kit (ms-appkit), the mobile kit (ms-mobilekit) and the apps catalog. A change here is a change in all three; the kits carry a vendored copy that their tests compare with this file, and the catalog build fetches it with the registry.

title.label: In one line
title.placeholder: e.g. Recording stops after the first power event

body_markdown.label: What happened, and what you expected
body_markdown.placeholder: Steps you took, what you saw, anything the app said.

files.label: Screenshots and files
files.prompt: Paste a screenshot, drop files here, or choose files.

attachments.hint: Up to 5 files, 5 MB each, 10 MB in all: png, jpg, gif, webp, pdf, txt, log, json, csv or zip.

wording.heading: Report a problem with {app}
wording.intro: What you write here goes straight to the team that maintains the app. Leave out passwords and customer data.
wording.details_note: The details below are collected automatically and go with the report, including which screens you opened and which buttons you pressed. Edit anything you like; what is sent is what this box says.
wording.failed: Machine Saver could not be reached, so nothing was sent. The whole report is on your clipboard; paste it into an email to {support_email}.
